properties.description: Cyclobutene minimum (C2v). Unimolecular gas-phase reaction: the pre-reaction complex is the isolated cyclobutene minimum itself.
properties.method: Gaussian16 PM7, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1

properties.description: Disrotatory (Cs, mirror-plane) ring-opening saddle. NOT accessible at the allowed level of theory: no first-order Cs saddle exists on the Gaussian16 PM7 surface. The Cs ridge top (C3-C4 = 2.2417 A) is a stationary point of index 2 (-179.98 cm-1 in-plane ring coordinate + -250.87 cm-1 out-of-plane CH2 wag), i.e. a hilltop, not a transition state; the exactly coplanar manifold has no maximum at all; four independent TS searches (including one started on the Cs ridge) collapse onto the conrotatory C2 saddle. Exploratory reference only (not a declared barrier): +42.8 kcal/mol above the cyclobutene minimum.
properties.method: Gaussian16 PM7, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1

properties.description: Conrotatory (C2-symmetric) ring-opening saddle. Geometry exactly invariant under the proper C2 operation (x,y,z)->(-x,y,-z) with C1<->C2, C3<->C4; C1-C2 1.390, C2-C3 1.415, C3-C4 2.108, C4-C1 1.415 A; single imaginary mode -838.10 cm-1 (both termini rotate in the same sense).

properties.description: 1,3-Butadiene. Lowest PM7 minimum is s-trans (C2h, central torsion 180 deg, E = 0.0432949126 Ha). The conrotatory IRC reaches the connected C2-gauche conformer (central torsion 45.7 deg, E = 0.0442136744 Ha); planar s-cis is not a minimum (one imaginary torsional mode, -96.86 cm-1).
properties.method: Gaussian16 PM7, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1

properties.description: Disrotatory ring opening (termini C3 and C4 rotate in opposite senses, preserving a mirror plane). No first-order saddle at PM7 -> no barrier declared. Exploratory only: the Cs ridge top lies +42.8 kcal/mol above the cyclobutene minimum and has Hessian index 2; it is a Woodward-Hoffmann-forbidden hilltop, and the reactive flux leaves the ridge into the conrotatory channel.

Conrotatory (Woodward-Hoffmann allowed for a thermal 4pi system) ring opening. Barrier = E(RPM7, TS) - E(RPM7, cyclobutene minimum) = 0.1127541314 - 0.0592543376 Ha = 33.57 kcal/mol, electronic energy, no ZPE. IRC in both directions plus unconstrained opt=tight freq endpoint optimizations prove the cyclobutene -> C2-gauche butadiene connection; reaction energy -9.44 kcal/mol.
